correctness.rationale: Disjoint simple quartic branch loci yield genus five by exact Riemann--Hurwitz. A prime-to-seven V4 quotient isogeny splits the Jacobian into two supersingular j=1728 elliptic factors and a genus-three hyperelliptic quotient. Direct expansion of ((x^4-1)(x^4-a))^3 gives the stated 3x3 Cartier matrix. Its polynomial semilinear one/two cycles prove all-parameter geometric rank/a-number conclusions. Two independent finite-field representations, for degrees 1,2,3, exhaustively confirm point counts. Genus-three Newton identities plus its Weil functional equation uniquely yield its degree-six zeta numerator; multiplying by (1+7T^2)^2 yields all five genus-five numerator factors. Both standalone programs ran to success from the proposed package paths; finite verification is not substituted for the symbolic all-parameter proof.

evidence: Kudo arXiv:2401.00760v1 is a general plane-model and singularity theorem for genus-five Howe curves with disjoint elliptic branch divisors; it does not give a p7 rank locus or degree-ten zeta factorization.

Ohashi arXiv:2604.18074 reports a preceding genus-five superspecial existence computation including characteristic seven and develops a broader different construction for larger characteristics; hence no first-existence claim is made.

A previously studied characteristic-seven genus-three reciprocal-quartic family has factors of the form (x^4+A x^2+1)(x^4+B x^2+1); a fractional-linear change of variable might relate its curves to this genus-three quotient, but it does not provide the genus-five zeta numerators of the double-elliptic fiber product.
broader_coverage.reasoning: The general geometric model and superspecial existence literature do not provide the five genus-five L-polynomials. The geometric Cartier-rank portion may be equivalent to a specialization of earlier characteristic-seven genus-three reciprocal-quartic rank formulae after a Möbius change of coordinate; the relation is unresolved and novelty is not asserted for that component in isolation. The exact five genus-five Hasse--Weil polynomials and resulting quadratic-extension maximality are not given by those rank results.

value.rationale: A natural one-parameter disjoint-elliptic generalized Howe family has two fixed supersingular elliptic quotients and one varying genus-three factor. Its exact all-geometric-coefficient Cartier locus and rational parameter L-polynomial spectrum are natural invariant classifications and exhibit a maximal genus-five member over F49. The information distinguishes the arithmetic behavior of the complete coefficient family, beyond routine check of a single curve.
